name: Relational Database
description: A relational (SQL) database — also called an RDBMS, Postgres/PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server, or Aurora — that persists structured business and user records in tables with transactional (ACID) guarantees. Queried by application services over a connection pool and the system's primary system-of-record. The place to look for the SQL/transactional database, structured data store, or where customer, account, and order rows live.
